none: PAS CAM-265C26: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Magnentius, 350-353
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES] ; D/ D N MAG[...]

A copper-alloy nummus of Magnentius, 350-353. AD351-353, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Reverse shows Two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT/V/MVCT/X. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Bare-headed, draped and cuirassed bust right, A to left. Obverse legend reads D N MAG[...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12…
